expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.A===60 && S.a1===50 && S.aine==='kruunu' && S.ulosP===true && S.ulosV===true && S.ulos===7 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: A = 60°, α1 = 50°, crown glass, every colour leaves the prism (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const s=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'); return R.length===2 && R[0].min==='30' && R[0].max==='70' && R[0].step==='5' && R[1].min==='20' && R[1].max==='80' && R[1].step==='1' && s.length===1 && [...s[0].options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')==='kruunu,flint,vesi' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: two sliders (A 30–70° by 5, α1 20–80° by 1) and one select (kruunu, flint, vesi)

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='A,a1,aine' && P.A.unit==='°' && P.a1.unit==='°' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares A (°), a1 (°) and aine
